risks.risk: Duplicate Telegram status messages (status edit + final send both sounding like completion)
risks.mitigation: Keep Status Complete as single editMessageText; gate wording only; do not add new Telegram send for preface

risks.risk: Losing operator feedback if success preface removed on clean path
risks.mitigation: Option D retains success wording for clean/repair-clean; Option C documents UX loss as acceptable trade

risks.risk: Blocking clean-path final materials by accidental connection change
risks.mitigation: Prefer expression-only change on Status Complete; no shared send-chain reorder in selected design
Do not touch Format Strict Reject / Parse Mode / Send Telegram Run; harness must assert reject send payload still produced

risks.risk: Memory append skipped if connections reordered incorrectly
risks.mitigation: Do not change HOTFIX02 memory-first fan-out; harness checks Prepare Memory / Append Memory reachability

risks.risk: Close Lock skipped if Status Complete removed as sequencing bridge
risks.mitigation: Keep Status Complete node and connections; change text only; never delete without rewiring Restore input
Regression guards: raw * = 0; plain-safe template; Parse Mode version marker preserved

risks.risk: Breaking PC-07 Close Lock task_id mapping
risks.mitigation: Do not edit Close Lock Before Sending expression; structural equality check in harness

risks.risk: Breaking Sheets status transitions / row writes
risks.mitigation: No Sheets node edits; lock/memory nodes disabled in sandbox and only structurally asserted
Intake/Admin out of scope; Worker-only sandbox

risks.risk: Sandbox disabled side-effect states copied to production
risks.mitigation: Production apply gates: re-enable side-effects from fresh production baseline; never copy disabled states

risks.risk: n8n parallel branch timing: status edit races final send wording
risks.mitigation: Keep Status Complete on linear shared chain before Parse Mode/Send; do not fan-out Status Complete parallel to Format*

risks.risk: Wrong gating predicate marks clean as reject (or reverse)
risks.mitigation: Harness fixtures for clean, repair-clean, blocked-dirty, error; fallback to Option C if predicates ambiguous after fresh production read

risks.risk: HTML entity issues in new Status Complete text
risks.mitigation: Keep status edits HTML-safe; avoid raw <>& and Markdown markers in status strings; do not switch Status Complete to Markdown
